patch.value: The CLI already discovers, validates, and subscribes to automation triggers. Stable Home Assistant Core also exposes test_condition, subscribe_condition, and execute_script. This feature completes the agent workflow from discovery and validation through runtime evaluation and guarded execution while retaining raw ws passthrough for future integration-specific contracts.
Add typed condition evaluation and action-sequence runtime
Complete the stable Home Assistant automation runtime workflow with typed one-shot condition testing, bounded condition observation, and read-only-safe action-sequence execution.

Typed commands accept validated inline JSON and JSON files with optional variables and detailed nested help; Condition testing and bounded observation preserve Core result and template-error semantics; Action-sequence execution is blocked before network I/O whenever read-only mode is enabled; Schemas, capabilities, README, API reference, docs index, LLM guidance, and agent optimization docs remain synchronized; Focused, integration, help, wizard, all-format, live, security, PM, auto-release dry-run, and exact 100/100/100/100 coverage gates pass
Official stable 2026.8.0 source and latest developer docs confirm contracts; live 2026.7.4 instance confirms compatibility; all-status PM and GitHub searches find no equivalent typed feature.
Let agents validate assumptions, observe condition truth, and run reusable action sequences without raw protocol construction.
Improves safety, explainability, and prompt efficiency for automation authoring and operation.
A production-ready typed automation runtime surface with private-instance-safe evidence and no release publication.
Static validation and trigger observation are already shipped; the remaining stable runtime commands form the next coherent agent workflow.
